turns.text: Hello po, this is Mia from ShieldLife, partner ng Banco Isla. Nire-record po namin ang tawag for quality and training. Hindi po ito hard sell — titingnan lang natin kung qualified po kayo sa term life o credit life cover. Pwede po bang makuha ang pangalan ninyo?
Hello po, ako si Ana Reyes, 32, from Quezon City.
Gusto ko sana term life, asawa ko ang beneficiary.

turns.text: Hindi po ako smoker. Magkano po ang premium for one million coverage?

Whole-life participating plan. Premiums payable to age 60 or 20 years, whichever later. Builds cash value after year 3. Optional **riders**: accidental death, waiver of premium, critical illness (20 conditions, 90-day waiting, 30-day survival). Beneficiary must be named; if none, estate. "Magkano ang premium" depends on age, gender, smoker status, sum insured - never quote a number that is not on the rate card. Ilang taon po kayo?
